_: GENERATED — what an authoring tool needs to FIND an operation. The calling table is the .lua beside it.

operations.name: Get all model details
operations.description: Get information of all models in an account, irrespective of the type of model (OCR model or Image Classification model).

operations.name: Get model details by id
operations.description: Retrieve a specific model's details given its ID.

id.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

operations.name: Prediction for image file
operations.description: Given an image file, extract data as per the label(s) specified in the model.

modelId.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

file.description: The file to be uploaded. **Format**: PNG, JPEG or PDF

operations.name: Prediction for image urls
operations.description: Given image URL(s), extract data as per the label(s) specified in the model. Multiple image URLs per request are allowed.

modelId.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

urls.description: Array of URLs of the training files. **Format**: PNG, JPEG and/or PDF

operations.name: Train model
operations.description: Train a model after uploading files to the model. The same end point is to be used to re-train a model after uploading more files to improve the model.

modelId.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

operations.name: Upload training images by file
operations.description: Upload a training image to the specified model using a locally stored file. On successful upload, model information along with the total number of images per category will be received. **NOTE**: Batch file uploads are not supported by this end point.

modelId.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

file.description: The file to be uploaded. **Format**: PNG, JPEG or PDF

operations.name: Upload training images by urls
operations.description: Upload training images to a model using image URLs. Multiple images can be uploaded in the same request by adding more URLs in the `urls` array. On successful upload, model information along with the total number of images per category will be received.

modelId.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

urls.description: Array of URLs of the training files. **Format**: PNG, JPEG and/or PDF

operations.name: Async prediction for image file
operations.description: Given an image file, extract data as per the label(s) specified in the model, asynchronously. This end point will send back a response as soon as the file has been uploaded, with a file ID. To retrieve the extracted data from the uploaded file, please use this file ID and hit the [Get Prediction File by ID](#operation/ocr/predict/id) end point.

model_id.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

async.description: Indicates that the request has to be processed asynchronously. **NOTE**: `true` is the only accepted value.

operations.name: Get all prediction files
operations.description: Retrieve the files that have been processed by the prediction end points.

model_id.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

start_day_interval.description: The start of the interval for which prediction files are needed. **Format**: Number of days since [Unix epoch time](https://www.epochconverter.com) **Eg**: 1620130500 seconds / 86400 seconds per day ~ `18,751` days

current_batch_day.description: The end of the interval for which prediction files are needed. **Format**: Number of days since [Unix epoch time](https://www.epochconverter.com) **Eg**: 1630930872 seconds / 86400 seconds per day ~ `18,876` days **NOTE**: The value of this parameter has to be greater than the value of the [`start_day_interval` parameter](#operation/ocr/predict/getfile!in=query&path=start_day_interval&t=request).

operations.name: Get prediction file by id
operations.description: Retrieve the prediction results of a particular file by its ID.

model_id.description: The ID of the model on which the operation is to be performed. It can be found in the model settings. **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`

id.description: The ID of the file for which the prediction has to be retrieved. It can be found in the response on uploading prediction files [synchronously](#operation/ocr/predict/file) or [asynchronously](#operation/ocr/predict/file/async) or while [retrieving all prediction file data](#operation/ocr/predict/getFile). **Eg**: `0a0aa000-0000-0a0-aa00-000a0000000a`
